verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a speech-to-text product, but the evidence only describes ElevenLabs' hosted HTTP/WebSocket API, Studio, and SDKs. EU/India data residency and zero-retention mode are related hosted-service controls, not the ability to self-host the core product. No on-prem, container, or open-weights deployment is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
